The law (LIRPF art. 66.1, version [2024-12-22,), effects 1 January 2025) has FIVE bands: 9,5 / 10,5 / 11,5 / 13,5 / 15 % with thresholds 6.000 / 50.000 / 200.000 / 300.000. The export's groups block defines only four (natrate1-4, lim1-3) although the fifth band's scalars ($tin_capinc_natrate5 = 0.15 from 2025, $tin_capinc_lim4 = 300000 from 2023) exist in the same export — so the schedule EUROMOD presents as an object is stale by one band. ROUTING: computed -> `changed` (4 brackets against 5). That is a finding about the group definition (enrichment side), reported alongside the value defects; when the groups block is fixed the case flips to `unchanged` and keeps testing every-bracket-right. The general scale (tin_schedule) cannot be a case: its rate scalars are 'n/a' in the export.
